name: Box or Bin
summary: One Remove pill splits into Archive or Delete forever: pack the order in a box, or shatter it
about: Box or Bin asks the one question every remove button should: keep a copy or delete it for good? The pill splits into two choices and the order card leans towards whichever you point at. Archive raises a kraft box that opens its flaps, swallows the folded card, tapes itself shut, gets stamped and flies to the Archive shelf; Delete forever cracks the card and shatters it into falling shards.
how: Press Remove order and the pill splits into Archive and Delete forever.
Hover or focus a choice to preview it; Keep it or Escape cancels.
Archive packs the card into a box that flies to the shelf; Bring it back unpacks it.
Delete forever cracks and shatters the card; Rewind the demo puts the shards back together.
